NIMBUS DYNAMICS PVT. LTD. - HIRING PROCESS
Document ID: HR-REC-001 | Version 3.2 | Last updated: 12 January 2026 | Owner: Talent Acquisition Team

1. PURPOSE
This document describes how Nimbus Dynamics hires employees, from raising a job requisition to the candidate's first day. It applies to all full-time roles in India (Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Pune).

2. HIRING STAGES
Stage 1 - Requisition: The hiring manager raises a requisition in the HRMS portal "PeopleHub". It must be approved by the Department Head and the Finance Controller. Approval takes up to 5 working days.

Stage 2 - Sourcing: The Talent Acquisition (TA) team posts the role on LinkedIn, Naukri and the company careers page (careers.nimbusdynamics.example). Employee referrals are open for 14 days before external posting for senior roles.
Stage 3 - Resume Screening: TA screens resumes within 3 working days. Shortlisted candidates receive a call from a recruiter.

Stage 4 - Interview Rounds:
  Round 1 - Online coding or aptitude assessment (60 minutes) on the HackerHub platform. Passing score: 65%.
  Round 2 - Technical interview (45-60 minutes) with two engineers.
  Round 3 - Managerial interview (30-45 minutes) with the hiring manager.
  Round 4 - HR interview (30 minutes) covering culture fit, salary expectations and notice period.
  Freshers (campus hires) skip Round 3.
Stage 5 - Offer: The offer letter is issued within 4 working days of the final interview. The candidate has 7 days to accept. Offers are signed digitally through DocuSign.
Stage 6 - Background Verification (BGV): Conducted by an external agency, TrustCheck. It covers education, last two employers and criminal record. BGV usually takes 7-10 working days.
Stage 7 - Onboarding: Day 1 is always a Monday (or the next working day). The new hire receives a laptop, ID card and a buddy.

3. SALARY BANDS (ANNUAL CTC, INDIA)
  Associate Engineer (L1): INR 6,00,000 - 9,00,000
  Software Engineer (L2): INR 9,00,000 - 16,00,000
  Senior Engineer (L3): INR 16,00,000 - 28,00,000
  Lead Engineer (L4): INR 28,00,000 - 42,00,000

4. EMPLOYEE REFERRAL BONUS
  L1-L2 referral: INR 20,000
  L3 referral: INR 35,000
  L4 and above: INR 50,000
The bonus is paid after the referred employee completes 90 days. Referrals for HR or Finance roles by employees of the same team are not eligible.

5. NOTICE PERIOD
Standard notice period is 60 days for L1-L3 and 90 days for L4 and above. Buyout is possible with manager and HR approval.

6. CONTACT
Talent Acquisition: talent@nimbusdynamics.example | Head of TA: Meera Iyer

NIMBUS DYNAMICS PVT. LTD. - HR POLICY HANDBOOK
Document ID: HR-POL-002 | Version 4.0 | Effective: 1 April 2026 | Owner: Human Resources

1. ABOUT THE COMPANY
Nimbus Dynamics Pvt. Ltd. is a cloud software company founded in 2015 by Rohan Mehta (CEO) and Anjali Rao (CTO). It builds logistics-tracking and fleet-analytics software. Headquarters: Bengaluru. Other offices: Hyderabad and Pune. Total employees: approximately 420.

2. WORKING HOURS
Standard working hours are 9:30 AM to 6:30 PM, Monday to Friday, with a one-hour lunch break. Core collaboration hours are 11:00 AM to 4:00 PM, during which employees must be available. Saturdays and Sundays are weekly offs.

3. WORK-FROM-HOME (HYBRID MODEL)
Employees follow a hybrid model: 3 days in office (Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday) and 2 days remote. Managers may approve extra WFH days for up to 10 days per year for personal emergencies. Fully remote roles require VP approval.

4. DRESS CODE
Business casual from Tuesday to Thursday. Casual wear on Monday and Friday. Formal wear is expected during client visits.

5. PROBATION
All new employees serve a 6-month probation. A review is conducted at 3 months and again at 6 months. Confirmation is communicated through a formal letter from HR.

6. PERFORMANCE REVIEW
Performance cycles run twice a year: April-September (mid-year review in October) and October-March (annual review in April). Ratings use a 5-point scale: 1 = Needs Improvement, 2 = Partially Meets, 3 = Meets, 4 = Exceeds, 5 = Outstanding. Annual increments range from 0% to 18% depending on rating.

7. CODE OF CONDUCT
Employees must treat colleagues with respect, avoid conflicts of interest, protect confidential data, and not accept gifts worth more than INR 2,000 from vendors or clients. Harassment of any kind is a zero-tolerance offence.

8. GRIEVANCE REDRESSAL
Employees can raise concerns with their manager, the HR Business Partner, or anonymously through the Ethics Hotline: ethics@nimbusdynamics.example or 1800-555-0142. The Internal Committee (IC) handles harassment complaints and acts within 30 days.

9. EXIT PROCESS
After resignation, the employee completes handover, returns assets (laptop, ID card, access tokens), attends an exit interview, and receives the full and final settlement within 45 days of the last working day. Experience and relieving letters are issued within 7 working days after settlement.

10. HR CONTACTS
HR Head: Sunita Verma | HR Helpdesk: hrhelp@nimbusdynamics.example | Extension: 2200

NIMBUS DYNAMICS PVT. LTD. - LEAVE POLICY
Document ID: HR-LV-003 | Version 2.5 | Effective: 1 January 2026 | Owner: Human Resources

1. LEAVE YEAR
The leave year runs from 1 January to 31 December. All leave is applied for and approved through the PeopleHub portal.
2. TYPES OF LEAVE
2.1 Casual Leave (CL): 8 days per year. Cannot be carried forward. A maximum of 3 consecutive days may be taken at a time without special approval.

2.2 Earned / Privilege Leave (EL): 18 days per year, credited at 1.5 days per month. Up to 30 days can be carried forward. Encashment is allowed for balances above 15 days at the time of exit or at year end (maximum 10 days encashed per year).
2.3 Sick Leave (SL): 10 days per year. A medical certificate is required if sick leave exceeds 2 consecutive days. Unused sick leave lapses at year end.

2.4 Maternity Leave: 26 weeks of paid leave for the first two children, and 12 weeks for the third child onwards, as per the Maternity Benefit Act. An additional 6 weeks of work-from-home is available on request.
2.5 Paternity Leave: 10 working days of paid leave, to be taken within 6 months of the child's birth.
2.6 Bereavement Leave: 5 days of paid leave on the death of an immediate family member (parent, spouse, child, sibling).
2.7 Marriage Leave: 5 days of paid leave, once during employment, for the employee's own marriage.
2.8 Compensatory Off: Employees who work on a weekend or public holiday with manager approval get a comp-off, which must be used within 60 days.
2.9 Loss of Pay (LOP): Leave taken without balance is treated as LOP, and salary is deducted on a per-day basis (monthly salary / 30).

3. PUBLIC HOLIDAYS
The company observes 12 public holidays per year, published each December. Employees also get 2 optional (floating) holidays per year chosen from a list of 6.

4. APPLYING FOR LEAVE
- Planned leave of 3 days or more should be applied at least 7 days in advance.
- Emergency leave must be informed to the manager by 10:30 AM on the same day, and applied in the portal within 2 working days.
- Managers must approve or reject requests within 2 working days; otherwise the request is escalated to the HR Business Partner.

5. LEAVE DURING PROBATION
Employees on probation accrue leave normally but may use a maximum of 1 EL day per month. Maternity and paternity leave are available only after 80 days of service.

6. SANDWICH RULE
Weekends or holidays falling between two leave days are counted as leave only if the employee takes more than 5 consecutive leave days.

7. QUERIES
Contact hrhelp@nimbusdynamics.example or extension 2200.

NIMBUS DYNAMICS PVT. LTD. - MEDICAL & HEALTH BENEFITS POLICY
Document ID: HR-MED-004 | Version 3.0 | Policy year: 1 April 2026 - 31 March 2027 | Owner: Benefits Team

1. GROUP HEALTH INSURANCE
Nimbus Dynamics provides group health insurance through "CarePlus Insurance" (policy number NDX-GHI-2026-0187). Coverage starts from the employee's date of joining.

2. COVERAGE AMOUNTS (PER YEAR)
  Employee + spouse + up to 2 children: INR 5,00,000 floater cover
  Parents / parents-in-law (optional): INR 3,00,000 cover, premium paid by the employee (about INR 9,500 per year)
  Senior employees (L4 and above): INR 8,00,000 floater cover

3. WHAT IS COVERED
- Hospitalization of 24 hours or more
- Pre-hospitalization (30 days) and post-hospitalization (60 days) expenses
- Day-care procedures such as cataract surgery and dialysis
- Maternity: normal delivery up to INR 50,000; C-section up to INR 80,000
- New-born baby cover from day 1
- Ambulance charges up to INR 3,000 per claim
- Pre-existing diseases are covered after a 12-month waiting period

4. WHAT IS NOT COVERED
- Cosmetic or plastic surgery (unless needed after an accident)
- Dental treatment, except in case of accidents
- Spectacles and contact lenses
- Self-inflicted injuries and injuries under the influence of alcohol or drugs
- Experimental or unproven treatments

5. CASHLESS CLAIM PROCESS
1. Visit a network hospital (over 4,500 hospitals are listed on the CarePlus app).
2. Show the e-health card and a government photo ID at the TPA desk.
3. The hospital sends a pre-authorization request; approval usually takes 4-6 hours.
4. The insurer settles the bill directly with the hospital. The employee pays only non-covered items.

6. REIMBURSEMENT CLAIM PROCESS
If treatment is taken at a non-network hospital, pay the bill and submit these documents within 30 days of discharge: claim form, original bills, discharge summary, investigation reports, and a cancelled cheque. Reimbursement is processed within 21 working days.

7. OTHER WELLNESS BENEFITS
- Annual health check-up: free for every employee once a year at partner labs (HealthFirst Diagnostics). Employees aged 40+ get an extended panel.
- Mental health support: 6 free counselling sessions per year with certified counsellors through the "MindEase" helpline: 1800-555-0177 (24x7, confidential).
- Gym / fitness reimbursement: up to INR 6,000 per year with proof of payment.
- Eye check-up camp is held every October at each office.

8. EMERGENCY CONTACTS
Benefits Desk: benefits@nimbusdynamics.example | Insurance TPA helpline: 1800-555-0123

NIMBUS DYNAMICS PVT. LTD. - ROOT CAUSE ANALYSIS (RCA) REPORTS
Document ID: ENG-RCA-005 | Maintained by: Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) Team

=====================================================
RCA-2026-014: FLEETTRACK API OUTAGE
=====================================================
Date of incident: 18 March 2026
Duration: 1 hour 47 minutes (02:13 AM - 04:00 AM IST)
Severity: SEV-1
Services affected: FleetTrack public API, mobile app live-location feature
Customers impacted: about 38 enterprise customers
Incident commander: Karthik Nair

SUMMARY
Customers received HTTP 503 errors when requesting live vehicle locations. The mobile app showed "Location unavailable".

TIMELINE
02:13 AM - Alert "API error rate > 20%" triggered on PagerDuty.
02:18 AM - On-call engineer acknowledged the alert.
02:35 AM - Database CPU found at 100% on the primary PostgreSQL node.
02:50 AM - Slow query identified: a new report endpoint was running an unindexed join on the "vehicle_events" table (about 240 million rows).
03:20 AM - Endpoint disabled using a feature flag; CPU started to drop.
04:00 AM - Service fully recovered; incident closed.

ROOT CAUSE
A release deployed on 17 March introduced a report endpoint with a query that lacked an index on (vehicle_id, event_time). Under the nightly batch of report requests, the query caused full table scans and saturated the database.

CONTRIBUTING FACTORS
- Query was not load-tested against production-size data.
- No query timeout was configured for the reporting endpoint.
- Reporting traffic and live traffic shared the same database node.

CORRECTIVE ACTIONS
1. Add composite index on vehicle_events(vehicle_id, event_time) - DONE 19 March.
2. Introduce a 5-second statement timeout for all API queries - DONE 25 March.
3. Move reporting workloads to a read replica - DONE 10 April.
4. Add mandatory performance testing with a 100M-row dataset in the CI pipeline - DONE 30 April.

=====================================================
RCA-2026-022: DELAYED NOTIFICATION EMAILS
=====================================================
Date of incident: 9 June 2026
Duration: 6 hours (delayed delivery)
Severity: SEV-3
Services affected: Alert and notification emails
Incident commander: Divya Krishnan

SUMMARY
Customers received geofence-breach alert emails up to 6 hours late.

ROOT CAUSE
The email provider's API key hit its monthly rate limit (500,000 emails) after a customer's misconfigured geofence generated over 180,000 alerts in one day. The queue backed up while retries were being throttled.

CORRECTIVE ACTIONS
1. Upgrade the email plan limit to 1,000,000 emails per month - DONE 10 June.
2. Add per-customer alert rate limiting (max 500 alerts per hour per customer) - DONE 24 June.
3. Create a dashboard and alert at 70% of monthly email quota - DONE 1 July.

=====================================================
RCA-2026-031: FAILED PRODUCTION DEPLOYMENT
=====================================================
Date of incident: 21 August 2026
Duration: 52 minutes
Severity: SEV-2
Services affected: Authentication service (user login failures)
Incident commander: Karthik Nair

ROOT CAUSE
A configuration change updated the JWT signing key in the staging secret store but was accidentally applied to production, invalidating all active sessions. Users were forced to log in again, and the auth service was overloaded by a login spike.

CORRECTIVE ACTIONS
1. Separate secret stores per environment with distinct access roles - DONE 5 September.
2. Require two-person approval for any production secret change - DONE 12 September.
3. Add gradual session invalidation and login rate smoothing - IN PROGRESS, due 30 November 2026.

=====================================================
RCA PROCESS
=====================================================
An RCA is mandatory for every SEV-1 and SEV-2 incident and must be published within 5 working days. It follows the blameless post-mortem format: summary, timeline, root cause, contributing factors, corrective actions with owners and due dates.

NIMBUS DYNAMICS PVT. LTD. - ENGINEERING & TECHNICAL DOCUMENTATION
Document ID: ENG-TECH-006 | Version 5.1 | Owner: Platform Engineering | Last updated: 3 September 2026

1. PRODUCT OVERVIEW
Nimbus builds two main products:
  - FleetTrack: real-time GPS tracking of vehicles with geofencing, trip history and driver scoring.
  - RouteIQ: route optimization engine that plans delivery routes using traffic data and vehicle capacity.

2. SYSTEM ARCHITECTURE
FleetTrack uses a microservices architecture running on Kubernetes (AWS EKS, region ap-south-1 Mumbai). Main services:
  - ingest-service: receives GPS pings from devices over MQTT (about 12,000 messages per second at peak).
  - location-service: stores and serves the latest vehicle positions (Redis cache + PostgreSQL).
  - geofence-service: evaluates geofence rules and triggers alerts.
  - notification-service: sends emails, SMS and push notifications.
  - auth-service: handles login using OAuth 2.0 and JWT tokens (access token validity: 15 minutes; refresh token: 7 days).
  - report-service: generates PDF/CSV reports using a read replica.

3. TECH STACK
  Backend: Java 17 (Spring Boot 3), Python 3.11 (RouteIQ optimization)
  Frontend: React 18 with TypeScript
  Mobile: Flutter
  Databases: PostgreSQL 15, Redis 7, ClickHouse (analytics)
  Messaging: Apache Kafka (3 brokers), MQTT (EMQX)
  Infrastructure as code: Terraform
  CI/CD: GitHub Actions + ArgoCD
  Monitoring: Prometheus, Grafana, Loki; alerting through PagerDuty

4. ENVIRONMENTS
  dev - auto-deployed on every merge to the "develop" branch.
  staging - deployed daily at 8:00 PM IST from the "release" branch.
  production - deployed Tuesday and Thursday between 11:00 AM and 3:00 PM IST. No deployments on Fridays or before public holidays.

5. CODING STANDARDS
- All code changes need a pull request with at least 2 approvals.
- Minimum unit test coverage: 80% for new code.
- Branch naming: feature/<ticket-id>-short-description, bugfix/<ticket-id>-short-description.
- Commit messages follow Conventional Commits (feat:, fix:, docs:, chore:).
- Secrets must never be committed; use AWS Secrets Manager.

6. PUBLIC API
Base URL: https://api.nimbusdynamics.example/v2
Authentication: Bearer token in the Authorization header.
Rate limit: 600 requests per minute per API key; exceeding it returns HTTP 429.
Key endpoints:
  GET /vehicles - list all vehicles
  GET /vehicles/{id}/location - latest location
  GET /vehicles/{id}/trips?from=&to= - trip history
  POST /geofences - create a geofence
  GET /reports/{id} - download a generated report
Error format: {"error": {"code": "string", "message": "string", "request_id": "uuid"}}

7. DISASTER RECOVERY
  RPO (data loss tolerance): 5 minutes
  RTO (recovery time): 60 minutes
  Database backups: automated every 6 hours, retained for 30 days; cross-region copy in ap-southeast-1 (Singapore).
  DR drills are conducted every quarter.

8. ON-CALL
Engineers rotate weekly on-call (Monday 10:00 AM to the next Monday 10:00 AM). Primary must acknowledge a PagerDuty alert within 5 minutes; otherwise it escalates to the secondary, then the Engineering Manager. On-call allowance: INR 4,000 per week.

9. SEVERITY LEVELS
  SEV-1: complete outage or data loss; respond immediately; updates every 30 minutes.
  SEV-2: major feature degraded for many customers; respond within 15 minutes.
  SEV-3: minor degradation; respond within 4 hours.
  SEV-4: cosmetic issue; handled in the normal sprint.

10. CONTACTS
Platform Engineering: platform@nimbusdynamics.example | CTO: Anjali Rao | VP Engineering: Suresh Pillai

NIMBUS DYNAMICS PVT. LTD. - TRAVEL & EXPENSE POLICY
Document ID: FIN-TRV-007 | Version 2.8 | Effective: 1 April 2026 | Owner: Finance Department

1. SCOPE
This policy covers business travel and reimbursable expenses for all employees. Travel must be pre-approved by the reporting manager in the "TravelDesk" module of PeopleHub.

2. TRAVEL APPROVAL
- Domestic travel: manager approval, at least 5 working days in advance.
- International travel: manager + Department Head + Finance approval, at least 15 working days in advance.
- Travel booking must be done through the company travel partner, "WingsAway Travels".

3. AIR TRAVEL
- Domestic flights: economy class only. Business class is allowed for L5 and above (VP level).
- International flights: economy class for flights under 8 hours; premium economy for flights over 8 hours for L4 and above.
- Book at least 7 days in advance to get the lowest fare. Last-minute bookings above INR 15,000 for domestic flights need Department Head approval.

4. TRAIN AND ROAD TRAVEL
- Train: AC 2-tier (2A) for L1-L3; AC 1st class for L4 and above.
- Local taxi / cab (Uber, Ola): reimbursable for client visits and airport transfers. Use of auto-rickshaw is reimbursable with a receipt.
- Personal car: INR 12 per km; personal two-wheeler: INR 5 per km. A log sheet is required.

5. HOTEL ACCOMMODATION (PER NIGHT, INCLUDING TAXES)
  Tier-1 cities (Mumbai, Delhi, Bengaluru, Chennai, Hyderabad, Kolkata):
    L1-L2: INR 4,500 | L3: INR 6,000 | L4 and above: INR 8,500
  Other cities:
    L1-L2: INR 3,000 | L3: INR 4,000 | L4 and above: INR 5,500
  International: USD 150 per night for L1-L3; USD 220 for L4 and above.
Hotels should be booked through WingsAway. Stays beyond 10 days require use of serviced apartments.

6. DAILY ALLOWANCE (MEALS & INCIDENTALS)
  Domestic: INR 1,000 per day (L1-L3); INR 1,500 per day (L4 and above)
  International: USD 60 per day (L1-L3); USD 90 per day (L4 and above)
No meal allowance is paid if meals are provided by the client or at a conference. Alcohol is never reimbursable.

7. OTHER REIMBURSABLE EXPENSES
- Internet / mobile data during travel: up to INR 500 per trip.
- Visa fees and mandatory travel insurance for international trips.
- Client entertainment: up to INR 2,500 per person, with prior approval and the client's name noted on the bill.
- Conference fees if approved by the manager under the learning budget.

8. NON-REIMBURSABLE EXPENSES
Traffic fines, personal shopping, mini-bar charges, spa or entertainment, extra baggage for personal items, and lost or stolen personal belongings.

9. CLAIM SUBMISSION
- Submit expenses in the "ExpenseHub" module within 10 working days of returning from the trip.
- Attach original receipts for every expense above INR 500.
- Manager approves within 3 working days, Finance verifies within 5 working days.
- Payment is credited with the next salary or within 10 working days, whichever is earlier.
- Claims submitted after 30 days will be rejected unless the Finance Controller approves an exception.

10. ADVANCES
A travel advance of up to 70% of the estimated trip cost can be requested. It must be settled within 7 days of returning.

11. CONTACT
Finance Helpdesk: finance@nimbusdynamics.example | Travel desk: travel@nimbusdynamics.example | Extension: 2400
